terms.comment: Our description: Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for a bicycle helmet. Galea is the classical helmet (Traupman 327); the adjective is made from birota, like Egger’s noun birotārius, a cyclist (M-O s.v. bicycle: cyclist).

sources: Lewis & Short: galea
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 327.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. bicycle: cyclist.
